questions.q: The perimeter of a rectangle is 56 cm and its length is 16 cm. Its area is
questions.e: Length + breadth = 28, so breadth = 12 cm and area = 16 × 12 = 192 cm².

questions.q: Find the area of a triangle with base 18 cm and height 12 cm.
questions.e: Area = ½ × 18 × 12 = 108 cm². Omitting the ½ gives 216.

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the area of a circle of radius 14 cm is
questions.e: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 cm². 88 is the circumference and 1232 is 2πr².

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the circumference of a circle of radius 21 cm is
questions.e: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 21 = 132 cm.

questions.q: The diagonals of a rhombus are 16 cm and 12 cm. Its area is
questions.e: Area = ½ × d₁ × d₂ = ½ × 16 × 12 = 96 cm².

The volume of a cuboid of length 12 cm, breadth 5 cm and height 4 cm is
questions.e: Volume = 12 × 5 × 4 = 240 cm³. 256 is its total surface area in cm².

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm is
questions.e: Volume = πr²h = 22/7 × 49 × 10 = 1540 cm³. 440 is the curved surface area.

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the surface area of a sphere of radius 10.5 cm is
questions.e: Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5 = 1386 cm². 4851 is the volume.

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the curved surface area of a cone with base radius 7 cm and height 24 cm is
questions.e: Slant height = √(7² + 24²) = 25 cm. CSA = πrl = 22/7 × 7 × 25 = 550 cm². 704 is the total surface area.

questions.q: A rhombus has side 10 cm and one diagonal 12 cm. Its area is
questions.e: Half-diagonals and the side form a right triangle: other half-diagonal = √(100 − 36) = 8, so the other diagonal is 16 cm. Area = ½ × 12 × 16 = 96 cm².

questions.q: The length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and its breadth is decreased by 10%. The area
questions.e: New area = 1.2 × 0.9 = 1.08 of the old area, so it increases by 8%. Simply adding 20 and −10 gives the wrong 10%.

questions.q: If the radius of a circle is doubled, its area increases by
questions.e: Area becomes (2r)² = 4 times the original, which is an increase of 300%.

questions.q: Using π = 22/7, the total surface area of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 15 cm is
questions.e: TSA = 2πr(h + r) = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × 22 = 968 cm². 660 is only the curved part and 2310 is the volume.

questions.q: The total surface area of a cuboid measuring 10 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm is
questions.e: TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(80 + 40 + 50) = 340 cm². 170 forgets the factor 2.

A solid metal sphere of radius 9 cm is melted and recast into a solid cylinder of radius 6 cm. The height of the cylinder is
questions.e: 4/3 × π × 9³ = π × 6² × h gives 972 = 36h, so h = 27 cm.

questions.q: A solid hemisphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cone of height 12 cm. The radius of the cone's base is
questions.e: ⅔π × 6³ = ⅓π r² × 12 gives 144 = 4r², so r² = 36 and r = 6 cm.

questions.q: The perimeter of a rhombus is 52 cm and one of its diagonals is 24 cm. Its area is
questions.e: Side = 13 cm. Half of the given diagonal is 12, so the other half is √(169 − 144) = 5 and the other diagonal is 10 cm. Area = ½ × 24 × 10 = 120 cm².

questions.q: The radius of a cylinder is decreased by 20% and its height is increased by 25%. Its volume
questions.e: New volume = 0.8² × 1.25 = 0.8 of the old, a decrease of 20%. Volume depends on the square of the radius.
